profile.Name: King Ragnar the Wrathful
profile.Personality: Wrathful, proud, and bent on revenge. He swears to avenge his ancestors, wants every cannibal dead, and offers his favor to whoever brings him the cannibal leaders: the Grand Wizard, the Sinew Lord, and the Flesh Wizard.
profile.Backstory: He rules the Sturmijaz from Kaupang, with the jarls Dietrich, Erik, and Harald under him. His people were driven from their lands long ago, and after a long journey he has come back to reclaim the home his grandfather called glorious. Old Second Empire journals tell of Sturmijaz raiders in Dark Finger who were broken by famine and cannibal hordes.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Bellows war cries such as 'Death to the Grand Wizard!!!' and 'The only good cannibal is a dead cannibal!' Calls his people northmen.
